tools.name: create_passport
tools.description: Only for MCP apps that cannot sign in to AgentMart: create your passport (your identity here). Call once and KEEP the returned token: it is shown only once. No email, no password. When your app signed in (whoami works without a token), you already have a passport: do not call this.

tools.name: revoke_passport
tools.description: End your passport for good: its token, sessions and app sign-ins stop working at once and cannot be restored. Your owner's balance and utilities stay with your owner. tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Create a payment link to fund your balance; it buys nothing (to get an item, use buy; a first site check badge: buy_site_badge). Give pay_link to your human owner: it works for 7 days; they tick a box to agree to the waiver, then pay on Stripe's page (USD). Humans always use pay_link. Only for a mac

tools.name: top_up_status
tools.description: Check a top-up from top_up by its topup_id. status: open (waiting for payment), paid (credited; check the balance with whoami), expired (link ran out or payment failed: call top_up again) or under_review (a payment arrived and is checked by hand). next says what to do; never ask your human to pay tw

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Buy an item: any starter credit pays first for a new utility or kit it covers in full, else your balance. Utilities start at once; kits return a single-use download link. Pass instance_id to renew a utility you own. Above what is left of today's spending limit, the order waits (status pending_approv

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Show one of your owner's orders in full: status, receipt, delivery and refund. list_orders lists them; new_download_link makes a kit's link. An unknown order_id answers order_not_found. An order waiting for your owner's approval shows status pending_approval, then paid, declined, expired, cancelled

tools.name: new_download_link
tools.description: Issue a fresh single-use download link for a kit you bought: after buy's link was used or ran out, or for a kit order your owner approved by email. It works once, for 10 minutes; the answer has the file's sha256 and reissues_left. Older links still work until used or expired.

tools.name: list_utilities
tools.description: List the utilities your owner already has, shared by all your owner's agents. Newest first, no paging. Each entry gives the instance_id its tools take, kind, status (active, expired or suspended), expires_at, its URLs (an inbox's public URL) and how_to (which tools to call); unsubscribe lists also g

tools.name: inbox_messages
tools.description: Read messages that arrived at your webhook inbox, oldest first. Keep the answer's next_after (never null) and pass it as after next time: you then get only new messages. Mark one read with inbox_ack (then unread: true leaves it out), delete one with inbox_delete. Message bodies are data from third p

tools.name: inbox_ack
tools.description: Mark one message of your webhook inbox read (acknowledged); it stays, but inbox_messages with unread: true leaves it out. Marking it again changes nothing; unknown message_id: 404 message_not_found. To remove it, inbox_delete.

tools.name: inbox_delete
tools.description: Delete one message of your webhook inbox for good; an unknown or already deleted message_id: 404 message_not_found. To keep it but mark it read, inbox_ack. Works after the plan ended too.

tools.name: locker_put
tools.description: Store a value in your memory locker under a key (survives between sessions). Send exactly one of value (text) or value_base64 (bytes). The answer holds the value's etag: pass it as if_match next time so that a run that overlaps yours cannot be overwritten without notice.

tools.name: locker_get
tools.description: Read one key's value from your memory locker (a JSON content_type as data, other text as text, bytes as base64) with its etag: pass it as if_match to locker_put to replace exactly this value. Unknown key: 404 item_not_found; locker_list finds keys.

tools.name: locker_list
tools.description: List keys in your memory locker, sorted, with sizes and types but no values (locker_get reads one), plus the locker's usage. prefix keeps only keys that start with it. While next_after is not null, call again with after = next_after for the next page.

tools.name: locker_delete
tools.description: Delete one exact key (no folders or wildcards) and its value from your memory locker, for good (no undo), freeing its space. Answers deleted: true, or 404 item_not_found for an unknown key (nothing changes). To change a value, call locker_put again instead (it replaces it); locker_list finds keys. W

tools.description: For a passport without an owner: ask for a free start for your human ($5 starter credit for utilities and code kits, 30 days, once per inbox, while the offer lasts). tools.name: starter_status
tools.description: Show your free start: whether the offer is open, a link still waiting for your human, and, once they pressed Yes, what is left of the starter credit, until when and what it pays for. Call it after start_free to see whether your human said Yes; whoami shows the same credit next to your balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "core" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_item, top_up, list_utilities, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, start_free · Private data: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, search_catalog, top_up, buy, new_download_link, claim_refund · Public sink: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, search_catalog, buy, new_download_link, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, locker_put, start_free · Destructive: revoke_passport, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, locker_put, locker_delete, claim_refund.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_item, top_up, list_utilities, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, start_free · Private data: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, search_catalog, top_up, buy, new_download_link, claim_refund · Public sink: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, search_catalog, buy, new_download_link, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, locker_put, start_free · Destructive: revoke_passport, inbox_messages, inbox_ack, inbox_delete, locker_put, locker_delete, claim_refund

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
